summary_en: The study tests LB-100, a drug given by vein, in adults with low or intermediate-1 risk myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS). LB-100 is given through an intravenous infusion over 120 minutes on days 1, 3 and 5 of each 21-day cycle. The record does not state the main outcome; it is a Phase 1 and Phase 2 study that looks at safety and effectiveness.
summary_es: El estudio prueba LB-100, un medicamento que se administra por vena, en adultos con síndromes mielodisplásicos (SMD) de riesgo bajo o intermedio-1. LB-100 se administra como infusión intravenosa durante 120 minutos los días 1, 3 y 5 de cada ciclo de 21 días. El registro no indica el resultado principal; es un estudio de Fase 1 y Fase 2 que evalúa la seguridad y la eficacia.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who sign the informed consent form.
Diagnosed with MDS or MDS/MPN that needs treatment for low blood counts, low or intermediate-1 risk by IPSS.
Disease progressed or not tolerated after at least 2 cycles of azacitidine, decitabine, or lenalidomide (lenalidomide only for del(5q) patients).
Adequate kidney function (creatinine clearance 60 mL/min or higher) and liver lab values as defined in the record.
not_for: Symptomatic heart failure, heart attack within 6 months, unstable angina, serious uncontrolled arrhythmia, or QTcF 450 msec or higher.
Other cancer diagnosed within the past year, with limited exceptions for resected skin cancers or carcinoma in situ.
Chemotherapy or experimental agents for MDS within 14 days before the first study dose, or ongoing growth factors such as ESAs, G-CSF, or GM-CSF.
